# xaci — Actuarial Climate Index (R package)

Implements the computation of the **Actuarial Climate Index (ACI)** and
its six components from gridded climate data (NetCDF ERA5) and tide
gauge stations (PSMSL).

> Reference: Garrido, Milhaud & Olympio (2025). *The definition of a
> French actuarial climate index; one more step towards a European
> index.* ⟨hal-04491982v2⟩

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installation

``` r

# From local sources
install.packages(".", repos = NULL, type = "source")

# Or with devtools
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install(".")
```

### Dependencies

| Package | Role |
|----|----|
| `ncdf4` | Read NetCDF files |
| `dplyr` | Manipulate tables |
| `zoo` | Sliding sums / means |
| `readr` | Read the PSMSL CSV |
| `ggplot2` | Visualisation |
| `tidyr` | Data reshaping |
| `sf` | Spatial operations (masks, admin polygons) |
| `rnaturalearth` | Worldwide coastline layer (sea-level factors) |
| `geodata` | Multi-level administrative boundaries (GADM) |
| `terra` | Required by `geodata`; also powers the memory-safe `engine = "terra"` option (see [`vignette("xaci-terra-engine")`](articles/xaci-terra-engine.md)) |
| `units` | Unit handling in spatial distance calculations |

Suggested (not required for core use):

| Package | Role |
|----|----|
| `ecmwfr` | Download ERA5 data from Copernicus CDS |
| `rnaturalearthdata` | High-resolution natural earth data |
| `patchwork` | Combine ggplot2 panels ([`plot_aci_dashboard()`](reference/plot_aci_dashboard.md)) |
| `gganimate`, `gifski` | Animated maps ([`animate_aci_map()`](reference/animate_aci_map.md)) |
| `knitr`, `rmarkdown` | Build the vignettes |
| `testthat` | Unit tests |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Documentation

The full walkthrough lives in the package vignettes, each runnable end
to end (most on a small self-contained synthetic dataset, so they
execute without any download or CDS account):

``` r

browseVignettes("xaci")
# or, individually:
vignette("xaci-intro", package = "xaci")
```

| Vignette | Covers |
|----|----|
| `xaci-intro` | What the ACI is, the four-step workflow, a first minimal example |
| `xaci-components` | Computing each of the six components individually (temperature, precipitation, drought, wind, sea level), and the `save` / `computed_components` caching pattern |
| `xaci-full-pipeline` | Running [`calculate_aci()`](reference/calculate_aci.md) end to end, reading its output, national vs. grid-cell mode |
| `xaci-visualization` | All six plotting functions: time series, component breakdowns, distributions, maps, dashboard, animated maps |
| `xaci-terra-engine` | The memory-safe `engine = "terra"` option for whole-country, multi-decade, hourly historical periods |
| `xaci-admin-levels` | Aggregating components and the ACI at the administrative-unit level (e.g. French departments) |

This README stays intentionally short: it covers installation, the
overall data flow, and reference material (the ACI formula, package
layout) that doesn’t belong in any single vignette. For actual usage
examples, see the table above.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## The `country_abbrev` argument

All functions that refer to a country accept a single format for
`country_abbrev`: a **three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code**
(e.g. `"FRA"`, `"GBR"`, `"DEU"`). The internal conversion to the format
required by each library (PSMSL CSV, GADM via
[`geodata::gadm()`](https://rspatial.github.io/geodata/reference/gadm.html))
is handled automatically.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Overall data flow

Setting up `xaci` for a new country follows **four sequential steps**.
Steps 1–3 are one-off, heavy computations; step 4 is the fast,
repeatable step you’ll use day to day once steps 1–3 are done. See
[`vignette("xaci-intro")`](articles/xaci-intro.md) for the full
explanation and a first worked example, and
[`vignette("xaci-components")`](articles/xaci-components.md) /
[`vignette("xaci-full-pipeline")`](articles/xaci-full-pipeline.md) for
everything past step 2.

    Step 1 (long)   Step 2 (short)   Step 3 (long)              Step 4 (fast, repeatable)
    ERA5 download → Country mask  → Grid-cell components     →  ACI / components at any
    (cache dir)      (cache dir)     (cache dir, .rds)           temporal & spatial level

- **Step 1** downloads the four required ERA5 variables (`t2m`, `tp`,
  `u10`, `v10`) via
  [`download_era5_all()`](reference/download_era5_all.md) /
  [`download_era5()`](reference/download_era5.md) — requires a free
  [Copernicus CDS](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu) account and the
  `ecmwfr` package.
- **Step 2** downloads a land/sea country mask with
  [`download_mask()`](reference/download_mask.md) (variable `"country"`,
  values in `[0, 1]`) — used by
  [`apply_mask()`](reference/apply_mask.md) to restrict grid cells to
  the country’s land area (threshold on the land fraction, default
  `0.8`).
- **Step 3** computes each component at grid-cell / monthly resolution
  and caches it (`save = TRUE`) — the expensive step, done once per
  country and reference period.
- **Step 4** reloads the cached components
  (`computed_components = TRUE`) and re-aggregates them on the fly to
  any temporal granularity (`"month"`, `"season"`, `"semester"`,
  `"year"`) and spatial level (national, grid-cell, administrative unit)
  — the step you repeat while exploring the data.

### Where things get cached

Steps 1-3 write to disk via a `dest_dir` (download functions) or
`save_dir` (component functions, plus `sealevel_dir`) argument. All of
these default to `NULL`, which resolves to a sub-directory of
[`tempdir()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/tempfile.html) — safe, zero-config,
and cleared automatically at the end of the R session, in line with CRAN
policy (packages must not write to the user’s home filespace by
default).

Since the whole point of steps 1-3 is to avoid repeating long
computations, you will usually want a directory that **persists** across
sessions. Pass your own path explicitly;
`tools::R_user_dir("xaci", which = "data")` is a convenient, per-user
location that works well for this (it is what `xaci` itself uses
internally to cache administrative boundaries):

``` r

data_dir <- tools::R_user_dir("xaci", which = "data")

download_era5_all(years = 2010:2020, country_abbrev = "FRA",
                   area = c(51.5, -5.5, 41.0, 10.0), dest_dir = data_dir)

temperature_component(..., save = TRUE, save_dir = data_dir)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## ACI formula

``` math
ACI = \frac{T_{90} - T_{10} + P + D + \alpha \cdot SL + W}{5 + \alpha}
```

| Symbol | Component |
|----|----|
| T₉₀ | Frequency of hot days (percentile 90) |
| T₁₀ | Frequency of cold nights (percentile 10) |
| P | Maximum sliding precipitation (5-day window) |
| D | Consecutive dry days (CDD) |
| SL | Standardised sea level |
| W | Wind power above 90th percentile |
| α | Coastal fraction (default = 1/5 nationally; computed per unit at administrative level) |

At the administrative level, α is computed automatically per unit as the
ratio of coastal length to total perimeter
([`assign_sealevel_to_admin()`](reference/assign_sealevel_to_admin.md)).
Units without tide-gauge stations use α = 0 and a denominator of 5. At
grid-cell level, α ∈ {0, 1} depending on whether a cell lies within
`max_dist_km` of a tide-gauge station. See
[`vignette("xaci-admin-levels")`](articles/xaci-admin-levels.md) for a
worked example.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Package structure

    xaci/
    ├── R/
    │   ├── aci.R                 # Main function calculate_aci() (engine = "base"/"terra")
    │   ├── component.R           # Base helpers (loading, mask, resampling)
    │   ├── component_terra.R     # Memory-safe loading & hourly->daily reduction (terra)
    │   ├── temperature.R         # Temperature component (T10 / T90)
    │   ├── temperature_terra.R   # Terra equivalent of temperature.R
    │   ├── precipitation.R       # Precipitation component
    │   ├── precipitation_terra.R # Terra equivalent of precipitation.R
    │   ├── drought.R             # Drought component (CDD)
    │   ├── drought_terra.R       # Terra equivalent of drought.R
    │   ├── wind.R                # Wind component
    │   ├── wind_terra.R          # Terra equivalent of wind.R
    │   ├── sealevel.R            # Sea-level component (PSMSL, not engine-dependent)
    │   ├── utils.R                # Shared utilities (standardisation, aggregation, masks...)
    │   ├── download.R            # ERA5 and mask download helpers
    │   └── visualization.R       # Plotting functions
    ├── inst/
    │   └── extdata/
    │       └── psmsl_data.csv   # PSMSL tide-gauge station metadata (bundled)
    ├── vignettes/                # See "Documentation" above
    ├── tests/
    │   └── testthat/
    │       ├── test-aci.R
    │       └── ...               # terra parity & NetCDF integration tests
    ├── DESCRIPTION
    ├── NAMESPACE
    └── LICENSE

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Package index

## All functions

- [`aci`](aci.md) : Actuarial Climate Index (ACI)
- [`aggregate_granularity()`](aggregate_granularity.md) : Aggregate a
  monthly data frame to a given temporal granularity
- [`animate_aci_map()`](animate_aci_map.md) : Animate the ACI or a
  component over time
- [`apply_mask()`](apply_mask.md) : Apply a country mask to a NetCDF
  data array
- [`apply_mask_terra()`](apply_mask_terra.md) : Apply a country mask to
  a SpatRaster
- [`assign_sealevel_to_admin()`](assign_sealevel_to_admin.md) : Assign
  PSMSL tide-gauge stations to administrative units and compute coastal
  factors
- [`build_admin_mask()`](build_admin_mask.md) : Build a spatial weight
  matrix mapping ERA5 grid cells to administrative units
- [`calculate_aci()`](calculate_aci.md) : Calculate the Actuarial
  Climate Index
- [`calculate_halfday_component()`](calculate_halfday_component.md) :
  Calculate the half-day (day or night) temperature component
- [`calculate_halfday_component_terra()`](calculate_halfday_component_terra.md)
  : Calculate the half-day (day or night) temperature component (terra
  version)
- [`calculate_maximum_precipitation_over_window()`](calculate_maximum_precipitation_over_window.md)
  : Calculate maximum precipitation over a rolling window
- [`calculate_maximum_precipitation_over_window_terra()`](calculate_maximum_precipitation_over_window_terra.md)
  : Calculate maximum precipitation over a rolling window (terra
  version)
- [`calculate_percentiles()`](calculate_percentiles.md) : Compute
  temperature percentile thresholds for each day of year
- [`calculate_percentiles_terra()`](calculate_percentiles_terra.md) :
  Compute temperature percentile thresholds for each day of year (terra
  version)
- [`calculate_period_wind_exceedance_frequency()`](calculate_period_wind_exceedance_frequency.md)
  : Calculate monthly wind exceedance frequency
- [`calculate_period_wind_exceedance_frequency_terra()`](calculate_period_wind_exceedance_frequency_terra.md)
  : Calculate monthly wind exceedance frequency (terra version)
- [`calculate_rolling_sum()`](calculate_rolling_sum.md) : Calculate the
  rolling sum of a climate variable
- [`cds_set_key()`](cds_set_key.md) : Set your CDS Personal Access Token
- [`component`](component.md) : Base Climate Component Helpers
- [`component_terra`](component_terra.md) : Terra-based Loading and
  Hourly-to-Daily Reduction
- [`days_above_wind_thresholds()`](days_above_wind_thresholds.md) :
  Calculate days with wind power above the 90th-percentile threshold
- [`.spatraster_to_list()`](dot-spatraster_to_list.md) : Convert a
  (small) SpatRaster back to the package's plain-list format
- [`download`](download.md) : Download ERA5 and Country Mask Data
- [`download_era5()`](download_era5.md) : Download an ERA5 variable from
  the Copernicus CDS
- [`download_era5_all()`](download_era5_all.md) : Download all ERA5
  variables required by the xaci package
- [`download_mask()`](download_mask.md) : Download the country mask from
  the Copernicus CDS
- [`drought`](drought.md) : Drought Component of the ACI
- [`drought_component()`](drought_component.md) : Calculate the drought
  component of the ACI
- [`drought_component_terra()`](drought_component_terra.md) : Calculate
  the drought component of the ACI (terra version)
- [`drought_interpolate()`](drought_interpolate.md) : Linearly
  interpolate annual CDD to monthly resolution
- [`drought_terra`](drought_terra.md) : Terra-based Drought Component
- [`load_component()`](load_component.md) : Load a NetCDF dataset and
  optionally apply a country mask
- [`load_component_terra()`](load_component_terra.md) : Load a NetCDF
  variable and optionally apply a country mask (terra version)
- [`load_netcdf_terra()`](load_netcdf_terra.md) : Lazily load a NetCDF
  variable as a terra SpatRaster
- [`load_psmsl_data()`](load_psmsl_data.md) : Load the bundled PSMSL
  station metadata
- [`max_consecutive_dry_days()`](max_consecutive_dry_days.md) :
  Calculate maximum consecutive dry days (CDD) per year
- [`max_consecutive_dry_days_terra()`](max_consecutive_dry_days_terra.md)
  : Calculate maximum consecutive dry days (terra version)
- [`plot_aci_components()`](plot_aci_components.md) : Plot the ACI
  component decomposition
- [`plot_aci_dashboard()`](plot_aci_dashboard.md) : Plot a summary
  dashboard of the ACI results
- [`plot_aci_distribution()`](plot_aci_distribution.md) : Plot the
  distribution of ACI components
- [`plot_aci_map()`](plot_aci_map.md) : Plot a spatial map of the ACI or
  one of its components
- [`plot_aci_map_mean()`](plot_aci_map_mean.md) : Plot the temporal mean
  of an ACI variable over a sub-period
- [`plot_aci_timeseries()`](plot_aci_timeseries.md) : Plot the ACI
  global time series
- [`precipitation`](precipitation.md) : Precipitation Component of the
  ACI
- [`precipitation_component()`](precipitation_component.md) : Calculate
  the precipitation component of the ACI
- [`precipitation_component_terra()`](precipitation_component_terra.md)
  : Calculate the precipitation component of the ACI (terra version)
- [`precipitation_terra`](precipitation_terra.md) : Terra-based
  Precipitation Component
- [`reduce_dataarray_to_dataframe()`](reduce_dataarray_to_dataframe.md)
  : Reduce a standardised spatial metric to a data frame
- [`request_sealevel_data()`](request_sealevel_data.md) : Download PSMSL
  tide-gauge data for a country
- [`resample_daily_terra()`](resample_daily_terra.md) : Resample a
  SpatRaster to daily resolution (terra version)
- [`sealevel`](sealevel.md) : Sea Level Component of the ACI
- [`sealevel_clean_data()`](sealevel_clean_data.md) : Replace PSMSL
  sentinel values (-99999) with NA
- [`sealevel_component()`](sealevel_component.md) : Calculate the
  sea-level component of the ACI
- [`sealevel_compute_monthly_stats()`](sealevel_compute_monthly_stats.md)
  : Compute monthly reference statistics for sea-level data
- [`sealevel_correct_date_format()`](sealevel_correct_date_format.md) :
  Correct PSMSL float date format to Date objects
- [`sealevel_load_data()`](sealevel_load_data.md) : Load sea-level txt
  files from a directory
- [`sealevel_process()`](sealevel_process.md) : Full sea-level
  processing pipeline
- [`sealevel_standardize_data()`](sealevel_standardize_data.md) :
  Standardise sea-level data over the study period
- [`standardize_metric()`](standardize_metric.md) : Standardise a
  monthly metric relative to a reference period
- [`temp_extremum()`](temp_extremum.md) : Compute daily temperature
  extremum (min or max) for day or night hours
- [`temp_extremum_terra()`](temp_extremum_terra.md) : Compute daily
  temperature extremum (min or max) for day or night hours (terra
  version)
- [`temperature`](temperature.md) : Temperature Component of the ACI
- [`temperature_component()`](temperature_component.md) : Calculate the
  full temperature component of the ACI
- [`temperature_component_terra()`](temperature_component_terra.md) :
  Compute the temperature ACI component (terra version)
- [`temperature_terra`](temperature_terra.md) : Terra-based Temperature
  Component
- [`utils`](utils.md) : Utility Functions for ACI Package
- [`visualization`](visualization.md) : Visualization Functions for the
  ACI Package
- [`wind`](wind.md) : Wind Component of the ACI
- [`wind_component()`](wind_component.md) : Calculate the wind component
  of the ACI
- [`wind_component_terra()`](wind_component_terra.md) : Calculate the
  wind component of the ACI (terra version)
- [`wind_power()`](wind_power.md) : Calculate daily wind power from u10
  and v10 components
- [`wind_power_terra()`](wind_power_terra.md) : Calculate daily wind
  power from u10 and v10 components (terra version)
- [`wind_terra`](wind_terra.md) : Terra-based Wind Component
- [`wind_thresholds()`](wind_thresholds.md) : Calculate wind power
  thresholds (90th percentile per day-of-year)
